gloss_en: Tzedek — 'righteousness/justice' (the noun צֶדֶק), used by Rabbi Nachman as a scriptural-kabbalistic term (e.g., 'tzedek tedaberun', 'tzedek yikra'ehu le-raglo') identified variously with Malkhut, garments, speech of Torah and prayer, and feet; not the verb צָדַק ('to be right'), not צְדָקָה ('charity'), and not the planet Jupiter
